highlights_headline: Work toward the next SkiaSharp 3.119.x servicing release is underway.

bullets.detail: Backports the 26.0 library and unversioned app target framework monikers from the v4 line to keep 3.119.x aligned on Apple platforms.
Fixes a missing WinUI Projection DLL that broke .NET 9 consumers.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported the Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs from the v4 line.
